name: Famine
value: Risk of Famine in Sudan; none confirmed
summary: FEWS NET assesses risk of Famine in parts of Darfur and South Kordofan; no area is classified as Famine as of 15 Nov
state: FEWS NET's Sudan update for September 2026 to January 2027 says the risk of Famine has spread to Sharg Aj-Jabal in South Darfur and persists in parts of North Darfur and around Kadugli and Dilling, but states that its findings do not establish a Famine classification. It reports that 13 of 20 nutrition surveys from June to September found Critical malnutrition. Searches on 15 Nov found no new IPC Famine classification. Risk-of-Famine alerts set Watch.
for_you: Famine risk in Sudan mainly affects displaced people in Darfur and Kordofan. FCDO advises against all travel to Sudan.
rubric_hit: Watch: FEWS NET 'risk of Famine' in Sudan (Sep 2026–Jan 2027); no IPC Phase 5 Famine confirmed

sources.title: FEWS NET — Sudan Key Message Update, September 2026 to January 2027

why: Famine is the most extreme humanitarian failure, almost always man-made by conflict.
drivers: War, sieges, aid access, harvest failure, funding cuts.

rubric.alert: Famine (IPC Phase 5) confirmed in at least one area.
rubric.watch: IPC Phase 5 projected or 'risk of famine' alerts.
rubric.normal: No IPC Phase 5 (Famine) classifications or projections.
